messages:
Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up: consolidating 'remote exceptions' + 'hybrid scheduling' into one short policy. Need two reviewers for wording and one owner for manager training RSVP + completion tracker. Publish target 2026-04-14.

Ben T: I can review wording. deadline?

Nora (People Ops): Reviews due 2026-03-28. Training drop-ins: 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-09.

Rina (Legal): I'll review EU wording; note that we must not imply contractors receive paid benefits.

Ben T: Doing wording pass now; suggest "manager-authorized remote exception" for clarity.

Sam: I can own the tracker and automations (RSVP + completion receipts). Please share CSV header.

Nora (People Ops): CSV header to use:
manager_name,team,email,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,training_session,verifier,notes
Include email so Sam can send auto receipts.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 10 days before first session and follow-up 48h after RSVP with no completion.

Rina (Legal): For DE/FR add a line about workplace assessments if remote > X weeks. I'll add a comment.

Nora (People Ops): Action items: Ben finalize wording by 2026-03-27; Rina legal review by 2026-03-29; Sam build tracker automations by 2026-03-30; Nora publish 2026-04-14. PR will be posted here when opened.

Ben T: Noted.

Sam: I'll seed tracker with managers from eng/product and share link.

Nora (People Ops): PR: https://git.company/handbook/policies/remote-exceptions-2026 — please add reviews.
